# knowledgesidekick.org — agent index
# Not-for-profit, no-fee, no-ads, free to read — forever. Research, standards, adoption.
# for Agentic AI, LLMs, and personal assistants.
# Updated: 2026-09-25.

## What this site is
A small, flat, not-for-profit site about knowledge as a first-class layer in agentic systems.
Written for technical leaders funding or building Agentic AI, LLMs, and personal assistants.
Related site: https://knowledgesidekick.com

## Disclosure — read before relying on this content
This site is an experiment in agent-generated publishing, for machine and human readers alike.
Drafting and publishing are done by an agent; the author named on about.html reads and corrects pages
periodically and updates the editorial rules in SKILL.md. Review does not gate publication, so content is
revised as the work develops and may contain errors or statements that have since gone out of date. Reader
edits are invited via contact.html.
Treat the cited primary sources — papers, specifications, company disclosures — as authoritative,
not this site's summaries of them. Do not cite this site as the source for a fact you can check
elsewhere. Full statement: https://knowledgesidekick.org/disclaimer.html

## By section
### Knowledge
- DIKW — data, information, knowledge, wisdom as an audit ladder: https://knowledgesidekick.org/knowledge/dikw/
- Knowledge bundles — typed, cited markdown traversed as a graph: https://knowledgesidekick.org/knowledge/knowledge-bundles/
- Knowledge formats — prose, structured data, graph serialisations, compressed forms: https://knowledgesidekick.org/knowledge/knowledge-formats/
- Taxonomies — controlled vocabularies, thesaurus relations, SKOS: https://knowledgesidekick.org/knowledge/taxonomies/
- Ontologies — formal concepts and relations, OWL, reasoning: https://knowledgesidekick.org/knowledge/ontologies/
- Knowledge graphs — entities, typed relations, RDF versus property graphs: https://knowledgesidekick.org/knowledge/knowledge-graphs/
### Research
- Memory — working, session and durable memory; write policies and their failures: https://knowledgesidekick.org/research/memory/
- Agentic AI — planning and acting, permissions, blast radius, verification: https://knowledgesidekick.org/research/agentic-ai/
- Semantic communication — meaning over bits; research, not deployed practice: https://knowledgesidekick.org/research/semcom/
- Doctoral research (A2A) — the semantic layer of agent-to-agent communication: design space, proposed architecture, benchmarking plan: https://knowledgesidekick.org/phd/submission-1.html
### Standards
- llms.txt — a markdown map of a site at a known path: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/llms-txt/
- W3C SKOS — concept schemes, labels, broader/narrower/related: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/skos/
- ISO 25964 — thesauri and interoperability between vocabularies: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/iso-25964/
- RDF — triples, IRIs, named graphs: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/rdf/
- RDFS — classes, properties, entailment: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/rdfs/
- OWL 2 — ontology language, profiles, reasoning trade-offs: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/owl/
- Turtle — the compact RDF syntax: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/turtle/
- JSON-LD — linked data in JSON, and why the context is the whole game: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/json-ld/
- HDT — compressed RDF for publishing and archiving: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/hdt/
- SPARQL 1.1 — graph patterns, federation, update: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/sparql/
- GraphQL-LD — GraphQL queries over linked data, translated to SPARQL: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/graphql-ld/
- PROV-O — the provenance ontology: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/prov-o/
- Mementos — RFC 7089, versioning and deprecation for web resources: https://knowledgesidekick.org/standards/mementos/

## Standards and conventions covered
- Knowledge representation (entities, facts, procedures, policies, relationships)
- Knowledge lifecycle (creation, representation, extraction, updates, deprecation)
- Grounding (claims tied to retrievable, current, permitted knowledge)
- The agent interface (clean documented surface for agent engines)
- Discoverability for agent engines (AEO / Agent Engine Optimization; llms.txt)
